cover_letter.greeting: Dear JPMorganChase Markets Investments & Acquisitions Team,
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Markets Strategic Investments & Corporate Development Associate role in New York. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. What draws me to this team is the scope: minority investments, acquisitions and partnerships across FICC e-trading, post-trade, digital assets and AI. I want to work where strategy and markets technology meet, and this team sits right there.

Two pieces of my background fit the analytical side of the role. In my MBA work I valued J.M. Smucker with comps, a DCF matched against a sell-side model and an LBO, and mapped packaged food M&A in Capital IQ by multiples, deal activity and returns. At JPMorgan Asset Management I worked on budget allocation across marketing channels: I built models on $10M of spend, benchmarked past allocations to find 30% in efficiency gains, and wrote executive briefs for senior leadership.

My valuation and M&A work so far comes from MBA coursework, so I'd be learning deal execution on the job. What I can bring from day one is careful valuation and market mapping work, clean materials for senior stakeholders, and familiarity with how the firm works. I'd welcome the chance to talk about the role.
